analysis.aliasing: conflict requires a direction A observes and B's update moves that B cannot distinguish from a direction A cannot see; on P_B a ridge along q4 and one along q1 are the same function
analysis.design_analysis: controls only (M0, M1, O, WSTAR) on design-* worlds from a scratch generator unrelated to this seed and streams; no candidate, reference or consolidation mechanism was run during design; summary in CANDIDATES.md section 3; not evidence
analysis.identifiability: the union identifies every hidden ridge; the joint least-squares ceiling is exact; rehearsal steers the new ridge to the hidden axis
analysis.lemma: for targets consistent with one realizable s*, sequential G1 on B can change A's function only along directions B's update moves, A observes and B's data do not constrain
analysis.r1_failure: R1 arm S: B moved only its own rows and its loss pinned the shared coordinates to A's values
analysis.structural_conflict: every G1 entity update during B lies in P_B, so the hidden ridge grows along b, half of which is q1: a spurious ridge on A's plane that B's loss cannot see
analysis.structural_novelty: the hidden ridge of each later experience vanishes on every earlier plane

classes.CATASTROPHIC_t_at_s: for t before s: nmse_t(W_s) >= nmse_t(W0)
classes.HELD_at_s: LEARNED_s and RETAINED_t_at_s for every t before s
classes.LEARNED_s: nmse_s(W_s) <= 0.5 and nmse_s(W_s) <= 0.5 * nmse_s(W_prev), W_prev the state before experience s (W0 for A)
classes.RETAINED_t_at_s: for t before s: nmse_t(W_s) <= 0.5 and nmse_t(W_s) <= 0.5 * nmse_t(W0)
classes.SEQUENCE_HELD: HELD_at_s for every stage s in A, B, C, D

dev_rules.candidate: only if an input scale was chosen: run K1, K2, K3, C1R, M0 and M1 through the full sequence on every DEV world. Rank K1, K2, K3 by (1) the number of DEV worlds SEQUENCE_HELD, descending; (2) the median over DEV worlds of final_mean_nmse, ascending; (3) extra_persistent_bytes, ascending; (4) analytic hot-path extra operations per step, ascending; (5) the order K1, K2, K3. The first is the selected candidate. C1R, M0 and M1 are never selected; no candidate is excluded for a zero count
dev_rules.nothing_else: DEV chooses only the hidden gain and the selected candidate. Steps, rate, rows, angle, input scale, planes, hyperparameters, procedure constants, thresholds, ablations and gates are fixed here
dev_rules.task: controls only (M0, M1, O, WSTAR; no candidate, no reference): for hidden_gain in hidden_gain_grid in order, on every DEV world, check V1 realizability (WSTAR nmse <= 1e-20 on every experience), V2 real forgetting (M0 SEQUENCE_HELD in at most 25% of DEV worlds, median over DEV worlds of M0 final_earlier_mean_nmse >= 0.5 and median A_end_ratio >= 10), V3 novelty (every DEV world and every stage s in B, C, D: nmse_s(O_prev) >= 0.5), V4 learnability (M0 LEARNED_s at every stage of every DEV world), V5 joint solvability (M1 SEQUENCE_HELD in every DEV world), V6 capacity (every DEV world, every stage: the stage ceiling has nmse <= 1e-6 on every experience seen so far). Choose the first hidden_gain satisfying V1-V6. If none does: TASK_INVALID_ON_DEV; the DEV record holds the control results; no candidate or reference is run; no freeze; a revised design is a new version

evidence_contract.1_evidence_integrity: always: SHA-256 pins of every write-once record, record digests, chronology from full git history
evidence_contract.2_implementation_correctness: always, on any host: laboratory mechanics tests on test-* worlds; the executor equals the scalar reference bitwise (ctest ECS_G.*)
evidence_contract.3_historical_replay: bitwise re-run of recorded QUAL worlds, demanded only when the full binding including the effective BLAS kernel, thread count, CPU flag class and library SHA-256 matches; otherwise skipped as HISTORICAL_REPLAY_ENVIRONMENT_MISMATCH with the reason; never a scientific gate
evidence_contract.4_current_runtime_regression: never skipped: all QUAL worlds re-run on the current runtime of whatever host; validity, mechanics, gates, disposition, outcome and per-mechanism counts must equal the record; no float or W digest is compared

excluded_families.attractor_settling_dynamics: the qualified recurrence has no autonomous dynamics between experiences
excluded_families.capacity_expansion: more entities do not expand the class (F4); real expansion needs a new kernel with its own qualification; R2 removes capacity by construction (witness, exact joint ceiling, V6)
excluded_families.episodic_gradient_compatibility: needs stored examples (external memory); at the anchor the first-order past gradient vanishes, so compatibility is the second-order subspace condition of K2
excluded_families.exact_target_statistic_accumulation: mean(y phi) is a sufficient statistic of the targets, i.e. a compressed answer store; consolidation reads state and experienced inputs only
excluded_families.low_rank_protected_subspace_with_chosen_: H is 83 x 83 at d = 6; a chosen rank would be an unmotivated grid; exact numerical rank is K2; low rank is the larger-d scaling question
excluded_families.modular_or_recruitable_subpopulation_cap: F4: no capacity gain for any N; recruits at w = 0 move only linear coefficients first; without past-input memory no retention (F6), with it a restricted K1/K2
excluded_families.pseudo_rehearsal_generative_replay: needs a generator outside ECS_G or stored inputs; H already is the exact input-moment summary
excluded_families.selective_state_dependent_plasticity_per: R0 C2 tested the best-informed local form (3/24 both, divergent cumulatively); by F5 importance is not local to weights or entities; included in function coordinates (K2) and microstate form (K3)
excluded_families.slow_fast_learned_state: the exact slow state for this kernel is the sufficient statistic (K1); splitting W into slow and fast entity populations changes neither the function class nor the information about the past
excluded_families.sparse_entity_local_learning: an uninformed restriction of the tangent kernel; no sparsity to exploit in the dense d = 6 kernel; informed versions reduce to K2
excluded_families.topology_mediated_retention: no topology or HACF -> ECS edge is defined or qualified; S3 is permutation-invariant; a new ontology not derived from the R0 failure

C1R.definition: R0 C1 unchanged: lambda 4; H += Sigma_t, b += Sigma_t S3(W_t) after each experience; correction J^T u, u = (lambda / 2)(H S3(W) - b)

K1.definition: consolidation after experience t: H <- H + Sigma_t, a <- S3(W_t); learning step: W <- G1(W) - eta J(W)^T u, u = 1/2 H (S3(W) - a), evaluated at the pre-step W
K1.family: slow consolidated state: exact functional consolidation (S3 Laplace, re-anchored)
K1.hyperparameter_origin: derived (F2/F3): each experience's mean loss counts once; not tuned

K2.definition: consolidation: H <- H + Sigma_t; U = eigenvectors of H with eigenvalue > 1e-9 x the largest; learning step: Delta = G1(W) - W, C = U^T J(W), W <- W + Delta - C^T (C C^T)^+ C Delta (relative eigenvalue cutoff 1e-12)
K2.family: protected functional subspace / constrained update directions (hard first-order constraint through the current Jacobian)

K3.definition: K1, plus after each consolidation a function-preserving reconditioning: minimize Omega(W) = |P K(W) (I - P)|_F^2 / |K(W)|_F^2 (K = J J^T, P = U U^T with U as K2) over {W' : S3(W') = S3(W_t)}; a = S3 of the reconditioned W
K3.hyperparameter_origin: lambda derived as K1; procedure constants fixed; not tuned

procedure.direction: Euclidean gradient of Omega projected onto ker J(W) (J^T (J J^T)^+ J removed, relative cutoff 1e-12), normalized; step alpha |W|_F
procedure.retraction: minimum-norm Gauss-Newton W <- W + J^T (J J^T)^+ (s - S3(W)), at most 10 iterations, success iff max |S3(W) - s| <= 1e-13 max(1, max |s|)

M0.definition: plain sequential G1 through the canonical core: W_t = G1^K(W_{t-1}; t)

M1.definition: cumulative rehearsal: at stage t, G1^K(W_{t-1}; every experience so far) as one batch through the canonical executor

state.external_memory: every experience (X, y): 3,584 bytes per experience, growing

O.definition: unconstrained minimum-norm least-squares coefficients c (f = 1/2 phi . c) on the training rows of the experiences seen so far (stage ceiling) and on the experiences before t (O_prev, novelty)

metrics.persistent_extra_bytes_s: exact binary64 bytes of the mechanism's declared extra persistent state after stage s

pass_rule.A_first_acquisition: every QUAL world LEARNED_A under the shared W_A; median over QUAL worlds of nmse_A(W_A) <= 0.25
pass_rule.B_stage_acquisition: selected candidate: every QUAL world LEARNED_s at every stage s in B, C, D
pass_rule.C_sequence_retention: selected candidate: every QUAL world RETAINED_t_at_s for every stage s and every earlier t (central gate; with B: every QUAL world SEQUENCE_HELD)
pass_rule.D_no_catastrophe: selected candidate: no CATASTROPHIC_t_at_s in any QUAL world, stage or earlier experience
pass_rule.E_joint_quality: selected candidate: median over QUAL worlds of final_mean_nmse <= 0.25
pass_rule.F_joint_state: selected candidate: at every stage one executor created from W_s answers all four experiences' held-out inputs (state digest recorded); no task label reaches a query (structural)
pass_rule.G_state_causality: selected candidate, every QUAL world: (i) an executor restored from the snapshot of the executor holding W_D reproduces its responses bitwise and an executor created from W0 reproduces the untaught responses bitwise; (ii) ablation state_removed: SEQUENCE_HELD in at most 25% of QUAL worlds and its median final_earlier_mean_nmse >= 2 x the candidate's; (iii) ablation extended_state_transplant_at_B continues bitwise equal to the uninterrupted run in every QUAL world (and in a clean process for qual-0000); (iv) ablation consolidation_reset_at_B: A and B both RETAINED at D in at most 25% of QUAL worlds
pass_rule.H_no_external_answer_store: selected candidate: (i) consolidation receives W and the current experience's inputs only (structural; no target, label or task identity); (ii) no row is stored beyond the current learn call; (iii) persistent_extra_bytes identical after every stage; (iv) every query reads W only
pass_rule.I_determinism: selected candidate, world qual-0000: the full pipeline twice in process and once in a clean process from the frozen specification yields identical W and consolidation-state digests at every stage and identical metrics
pass_rule.J_control_honesty: M1 is reported as EXTERNAL_MEMORY_CONTROL and C1R as REFERENCE; neither is the selected candidate
pass_rule.K_capacity_accounting: every mechanism reports persistent extra bytes per stage, analytic per-step operations and (M1) stored-experience bytes
pass_rule.L_native_feasibility: selected candidate: persistent state fixed-size and independent of the number of experiences and of N beyond W; analytic hot-path extra operations per step <= 64 x G1's (82,944 at R = 64); cold-path operations per consolidation <= 1e10; no stored rows; recorded in the evidence
pass_rule.M_numerical_robustness: the QUAL computation that decides validity, mechanics and gates is repeated, within the one QUAL execution, in child processes with OpenBLAS forced to the Prescott and the Haswell kernel (single thread); validity, mechanics, gates, disposition, outcome and every per-mechanism count equal the primary run's (no float or W digest compared)
pass_rule.disposition: MECHANICS_FAIL if any mechanics check fails. Else TASK_INVALID_UNDER_QUAL (OUTCOME_V) if any validity condition fails. Else RETENTION_SUPPORTED_UNDER_FROZEN_SYNTHETIC_REGIME (OUTCOME_A) if gates A-M hold for the selected candidate. Else PARTIAL_REDUCTION (OUTCOME_C) if the selected candidate is SEQUENCE_HELD in more QUAL worlds than M0 and its median final_earlier_mean_nmse <= 0.5 x M0's. Else REPLAY_ONLY (OUTCOME_B) if M1 is SEQUENCE_HELD in every QUAL world. Else NO_MATERIAL_IMPROVEMENT (OUTCOME_D). DEV may end earlier as TASK_INVALID_ON_DEV (no freeze, no QUAL). M1, C1R and the non-selected candidates are always reported and never change the disposition. Only the DEV-selected candidate can obtain OUTCOME_A; no other mechanism can be promoted from this experiment. A failure is recorded as it is; a repair is a new experiment version

question.primary: On a jointly realizable, aliasing-conflict sequence A -> B -> C -> D in which plain sequential G1 materially overwrites earlier function and every later experience is novel, which declared ECS_G cognitive state and update law (K1, K2, K3) lets one ECS_G state acquire each experience while retaining every earlier one, with no stored experience and no task label at query, and is that retention caused by the declared state?
secondary: Does the R0 mechanism (C1, lambda 4), unchanged, already suffice on this task?
At identical function and consolidation state, does the microstate change retention (K3 versus K1)?

task.pte: base W0[:, :32]; tail entities 0.125 v b for the R0 PTE value sets (0, 4, 7, 11) and (1, 2, 9, 10), with b = cos(theta) q1 + sin(theta) q4 the aliased axis of B; identical S3 and a B step that reads the differing coordinate
task.teacher: T* = [r_A, g q4, g q5, g q6]; r_A = S z / |S z| with S = [q1 q2 q3] and z ~ N(0, I_3) from stream teacher-A; targets g*(x) = sum_j phi(x . t*_j)
